attrs.Help_string: What this block does: Creates a ribbon, Copyright (C) 2018 Orkhan Ashrafov. How to use it: fill the key fields below before build. SetParent: set the target node name. If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup. Equal: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. Ctrls: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 5). Joints: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 5). Constraint: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. AddFk: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature. Tip: if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly. Template parent examples: Spine_End_Jnt, Head_Jnt, L_Wrist_Jnt.
